title: CR-PAY-050 — Vendor + part-sales + AP/AR
preconds: Permissions (counted): Vendor & Order V+E + Part Sales V+E + See AP/AR. Auto-gate forced ON (not counted): Parts Dept + See Fin. View Mode: Full unless noted. All other permissions OFF.
steps:
1. Create a custom role with the permissions listed in Preconditions; leave all others OFF.
  2. Assign the role to a test user and log in.
  3. Exercise each capability in Expected Result and confirm it succeeds (and that gated pricing is hidden where noted).
expected:
User CAN: Create/edit vendors, POs, deliveries, vendor invoices; part sales & returns; process transactions; vendor & customer AP/AR payment tabs; aging; bulk payments

Risk / Rationale: Positive capability check — confirms this combination grants exactly the listed actions and nothing gated leaks. See Flag / Note.
Spec Ref: §1g+§1e+§5b
Flag / Note: \u26a0 no Invoicing E — bulk payments via AP/AR only (§5b vs §1h)
